summary: Backend tests for iteration 184: banks dynamic contacts repeater (POST/PUT/GET legacy migration), suggested-contacts for projects, preview-notification matrix qty inheritance, inject_custom_message helper, and irregular quotes report rule. 6/7 tests pass; 1 BUG confirmed in irregular-quotes detection.

critical.issue: Rule 'Pasó a Proyecto sin Aprobación previa' NEVER fires for legacy quote_history records. _detect_irregularities (sales_reports.py:784,815) checks `archived_trigger.lower().startswith('enviada a imple')` but real DB values are 'status_enviada_imple' and 'status_enviada_imple_recovered'. There are 3 records (COT-2026-04-026/028/029-PYME) with archived_trigger='status_enviada_imple_recovered' and approved_at=None that should be flagged but are not returned.

minor.issue: Endpoint stores the synced legacy fields (contact_name/email/phone) into MongoDB doc, but `return bank` returns the original Pydantic model without those synced legacy fields. UI receives None for contact_email/phone right after creation; subsequent GET returns correct data. Fix: return doc / re-fetch / mutate the model. Lines 184-201 in routes/banks.py.

action_items: Fix _detect_irregularities in /app/backend/routes/sales_reports.py: change archived_trigger check from startswith('enviada a imple') to also match 'status_enviada_imple' / 'status_enviada_imple_recovered' (case-insensitive contains 'enviada_imple' or 'enviada a imple'). Lines 784 and 815. Same fix needed in `passed_to_project` flag at lines 858 and 913.
Make POST /api/banks response include the legacy-sync fields (return updated doc, not original bank model) so UI sees contact_name/email/phone immediately after creation.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/banks.py POST create_bank: sync mutates `doc` but response uses original `bank` model — divergence between DB state and API response.
routes/sales_reports.py: archived_trigger comparison is brittle. Project uses two value families ('Enviada a Imple' label and 'status_enviada_imple*' code). Standardize or normalize before checks.
models.py BankCreate has Optional contact_name/email/phone but routes mutate them post-validation — explicit doc verification needed in tests.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted ephemeral TEST_Bank_<uuid> with 3 contacts during run; cleaned up by fixture teardown.

Re-run after main agent fixes the archived_trigger string comparison in _detect_irregularities. Sample failing data: quote_history docs with archived_trigger in ('status_enviada_imple','status_enviada_imple_recovered') and approved_at=None (3 in DB).

rca of the issue.bug: Pasó a Proyecto sin Aprobación previa rule never appears in irregular-quotes report.
rca of the issue.reproduction: GET /api/reports/sales/irregular-quotes (admin token) → returned items only contain 'Falta fecha de Pagada/Configurada'; no entry has 'Pasó a Proyecto sin Aprobación previa' even though 3 quote_history rows match the requirement.
rca of the issue.root_cause: In /app/backend/routes/sales_reports.py the helper builds is_to_project = archived_trigger.lower().startswith('enviada a imple'). DB stores archived_trigger as 'status_enviada_imple' / 'status_enviada_imple_recovered', so the predicate is always False for history rows.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Replace startswith('enviada a imple') with a normalized check, e.g. 'enviada_imple' in trigger.lower().replace(' ','_') or normalize trigger to a canonical token. Apply to lines 784, 815, 858, 913.
